headline: Congress awards one Congressional Gold Medal to 60 diplomats who saved Jews during World War II, honoring them after their deaths.
what_it_does: This law gives a single Congressional Gold Medal, awarded after death, to 60 diplomats for their service in saving Jews during World War II. The one medal is presented as a group to the eldest next of kin of each of the 60 diplomats. After that presentation, the medal goes to the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 12, 2024. The official summary does not give a date for the medal presentation.
